correctness.rationale: Assaf et al. Cor.5.8 identifies connected closed oriented surface components indexed by Lagrangian planes and wedge labels modulo ± and glued only along vertices, with disjoint one-/two-simplices, so top homology is direct sum of signed orientation lines. There are (p+1)(p²+1) Lagrangians and (p-1)/2 labels each. The action is transitive via symplectic basis extension; stabilizer determinant ±1. An integral lift with det ±1 acts on symmetric-square surface orientation with sign det(A)^3=det(A), giving Ind_H^G epsilon. Fixed labels imply determinant ±1 and sign; transvection-fixed Lagrangians are precisely p+1 containing its axis; a ± symplectic split involution fixes (p+1)² mixed lines with sign -1. Cyclic C_p multiplicities follow from character averaging; Frobenius reciprocity kills full invariants. Independently enumerated 40 Lagrangians for p=3 and 156 for p=5 and checked transvection/involution fixed-plane counts and traces. Finite p checks corroborate but do not prove all-prime theorem.

value.rationale: The equivariant H² character is a structural refinement of a natural tropical Siegel moduli-space invariant, separating orientation-sensitive symplectic involutions and giving complete closed-form transvection restrictions. Negative involution trace distinguishes it sharply from unsigned permutation counts. Not a trivial Betti-number rename.

final_claim: For each odd prime p, rational H² of the tropical genus-two full-level p Siegel link is Ind_H^{Sp4(Fp)} epsilon from a signed Lagrangian-surface stabilizer, dimension (p^4-1)/2; character chi(g)=(p-1)/2[N_+(g)-N_-(g)], with transvection and symplectic involution traces (p²-1)/2 and -(p-1)(p+1)²/2, rational cyclic transvection decomposition, and no Sp4-fixed part. Same rational action in W0 Hc³ of A2[p].
